product.name: Indio by Monoprice DS-6 True Bypass Analog Vintage Distortion Full-size Guitar Effect Pedal
product.description: Indio™ by Monoprice™              DS‑6 True Bypass Distortion              Guitar Effect Pedal                  The mid‑to‑late 70s distortion pedal has gained legendary status as possibly the best ever made, making its imprint in popular rock music and defining its sound. But what is most impressive about its tone is the fact that it has yet to be improved, as other distortion box designs have fallen short of that standard. As a tribute to the stompbox legend, Indio™ Guitars faithfully recreated the design and vintage tone of the mid‑to‑late 70s distortion pedal with its DS‑6 True Bypass Distortion Guitar Effect Pedal.                                    True bypass design          Faithful reproduction of mid‑to‑late 70s distortion          Full‑size pedal with all metal construction                                      Powered by 9V battery or external power adapter          High‑impact, high‑quality switches          Fully analog                                                                                                                      LEGENDARY VINTAGE DISTORTION                                                          The Indio™ DS‑6 True Bypass Distortion Guitar Effect Pedal faithfully reproduces the tone of legendary distortion pedals of the mid‑to‑late 70s and early 80s, which were mostly characterized by their simple design and ample available gain. Despite their over‑the‑top potential, these distortion pedals are versatile, as they can be run at every gain stage with equally awesome results.                                      Additionally, they take guitar volume changes exceptionally well, giving you yet another layer to perfectly dial in your tone. The Indio™ DS‑6 True Bypass Distortion Guitar Effect Pedal uses comparable, yet modern components (operational amplifiers and chips) to replicate the character that made the originals the best vintage distortion pedals ever made.                                                                                                                                            TRUE BYPASS DESIGN AND FULL METAL CONSTRUCTION                                                          Unlike most inexpensive guitar pedals, Indio™ pedals feature a true bypass design, keeping your tone pristine when not engaged. Other boutique guitar pedals featuring a true bypass design will cost several times more, while using the same components inside every Indio pedal.                                      Additionally, Indio true bypass guitar effects feature full metal construction, ensuring that they can withstand the rigors of the road. The full‑size housing provides enough separation on your board, reducing the crowding issues associated with inexpensive mini pedals.                                                                                                                                            VERSATILE POWER                                                          Indio™ true bypass guitar effect pedals can be powered either by a 9V battery or an external power supply, making them both versatile and venue/scenario‑proof. Use the 611690 Stage Right™ 9V Power Supply for Guitar Pedals (available separately) when playing at home, in your practice space, or when power is easily accessible at the venue. Alternatively, you can use a 9V battery to be free from extra cables or when power outlets aren't accessible.
